item.title: New Search Tools Index Technical Candidates Seeking Software Engineering Roles
item.description:
New Search Tools Index Technical Candidates Seeking Software Engineering Roles

New search platforms have emerged to index and highlight technical professionals seeking new opportunities. Tools such as nthesis.ai/public/hn-wants-to-be-hired and wantstobehired.com allow recruiters and hiring managers to search through developer profiles sourced from the Hacker News community.

🔍 Overview

The search directories aggregate candidates with specialized backgrounds in backend engineering, full-stack systems, robotics, and emerging AI technologies. The available talent pool includes highly experienced remote workers, open-source maintainers, and specialized engineering undergraduates.

⚙️ Key details

A diverse range of candidates are listed across these search platforms, detailing their specific technical stacks and track records:

Location Core Technologies Highlights & Experience
Curitiba, Brazil Rust, Go, TypeScript/Node, Elixir/Phoenix, Python, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Docker, AWS/GCP, Next.js / React, agent harnesses / LLM product engineering 10+ years remote with US/Canada/EU teams; 9 years across three teams with zero production incidents on owned high-scale systems.
Oakland, CA Rust, Axum, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Python, Flask, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes Created Lita (Ruby ChatOps framework used for automating internal workflows) and Ruma (Matrix protocol in Rust, which became the basis for the official Rust SDK); 4 years as cloud-side tech lead for Cisco Meraki wireless products. Email: jimmy@jimmycuadra.com
Seoul, South Korea Flutter, Spring Boot/WebFlux, Laravel, React, Vue, TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, MySQL, Redis, AWS, Cloudflare Workers, Docker, Electron 13 years building full-stack applications; recently shipped a kids news app for a Dong-A Ilbo subsidiary, rebuilt its backend on Spring Boot WebFlux, and previously built a study-cafe kiosk system, a healthcare platform, and a chat app.
Buffalo, NY ros2, Go, Python, Tanstack, Svelte, Docker, Linux Computer Engineering undergraduate with experience building rovers and working with robot learning frameworks to build robotics frameworks.
Kocaeli, Turkey React, Vue, Next.js, Svelte, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, Git, AI SDK, Tanstack AI, Tanstack Start, Node.JS, Nest.JS, Express.js, React Native, Storybook, Vite Frontend and full-stack developer experienced in modern JavaScript frameworks and AI SDK tools.
Bay Area Rust Senior IC seeking remote roles with real ownership and Rust-first backends.
California, US Python, Django, React, Typescript, PostgreSQL, Docker Full-stack developer.

🚀 Availability

The listed candidates offer varying availability and working arrangements:

  • Remote-Only Candidates: Several engineers, including those based in Curitiba, Brazil and Kocaeli, Turkey, are seeking strictly remote roles or B2B contracts.
  • Global Overlap: The candidate based in Seoul, South Korea is available starting February 2027 and can provide a few hours of timezone overlap with European or US-morning teams.
  • Internships: The Computer Engineering undergraduate based in Buffalo, NY is specifically seeking summer 2027 intern roles and is willing to work anywhere in the United States.

#JobSearch #SoftwareEngineering #HackerNews #TechTalent #RemoteWork

Source: Ask HN: Who wants to be hired? (September 2026)
